CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles(id, display_name)
  values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name'))
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.knoux_bridge_claim_job(p_machine_id uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF knoux_bridge_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_job_id uuid;
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.knoux_bridge_sessions s
    where s.id = p_session_id
      and s.machine_id = p_machine_id
      and s.revoked_at is null
      and s.expires_at > now()
  ) then
    return;
  end if;

  update public.knoux_bridge_jobs
     set status = 'expired', completed_at = now()
   where machine_id = p_machine_id
     and status = 'queued'
     and expires_at <= now();

  select j.id into v_job_id
    from public.knoux_bridge_jobs j
   where j.machine_id = p_machine_id
     and j.status = 'queued'
     and j.expires_at > now()
   order by j.created_at
   for update skip locked
   limit 1;

  if v_job_id is null then return; end if;

  return query
    update public.knoux_bridge_jobs
       set status = 'claimed',
           claimed_session_id = p_session_id,
           claimed_at = now()
     where id = v_job_id
     returning *;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, owner_id uuid, bridge_id text)

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_enrollment_id uuid;

  v_machine_id uuid;
begin
  select e.id, e.owner_id
    into v_enrollment_id, v_owner_id
    from public.knoux_bridge_enrollments e
   where e.token_hash = p_token_hash
     and e.used_at is null
     and e.expires_at > now()
   for update
   limit 1;

  if v_enrollment_id is null then
    return;

  insert into public.knoux_bridge_machines (
    owner_id,
    bridge_id,
    fingerprint,
    public_key,
    hostname,
    platform,
    arch,
    bridge_version,
    capabilities,

    v_owner_id,
    p_bridge_id,
    p_fingerprint,
    p_public_key,
    p_hostname,
    p_platform,
    p_arch,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.signal_promote_business_staging(p_dataset_key text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  dataset_row public.signal_datasets;
  source_row public.signal_source_catalog;
  promoted_count integer := 0;
begin
  select * into dataset_row
  from public.signal_datasets
  where dataset_key = p_dataset_key
  for update;

  if dataset_row.id is null then
    raise exception 'dataset_not_found';
  end if;
  if dataset_row.legal_status <> 'approved' then
    raise exception 'dataset_not_approved';
  end if;

  select * into source_row
  from public.signal_source_catalog
  where id = dataset_row.source_id;

  if source_row.id is null
     or source_row.approval_status <> 'approved'
     or not source_row.enabled then
    raise exception 'source_not_approved_and_enabled';
  end if;

  update public.signal_datasets
  set ingestion_status='promoting', updated_at=now()
  where id=dataset_row.id;

  insert into public.signal_business_phone_records (
    source_id, source_record_id, phone_e164, country_code, business_name,
    category, locality, source_url, fetched_at, provenance
  )
  select
    dataset_row.source_id,
    coalesce(nullif(s.payload->>'source_record_id',''), s.source_record_fingerprint),
    s.phone_e164,
    s.country_code,
    left(s.payload->>'business_name', 300),
    nullif(s.payload->>'category',''),
    nullif(s.payload->>'locality',''),
    nullif(s.payload->>'source_url',''),
    now(),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'pipeline','signal_promote_business_staging',
      'dataset_key',dataset_row.dataset_key,
      'dataset_id',dataset_row.id,
      'source_record_fingerprint',s.source_record_fingerprint
    )
  from public.signal_source_records_staging s
  where s.dataset_id=dataset_row.id
    and s.status='staged'
    and s.record_kind='business_phone'
    and s.phone_e164 ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$'
    and nullif(trim(s.payload->>'business_name'),'') is not null
  on conflict(source_id, source_record_id, phone_e164) do update set
    country_code=excluded.country_code,
    business_name=excluded.business_name,
    category=excluded.category,
    locality=excluded.locality,
    source_url=excluded.source_url,
    fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at,
    provenance=excluded.provenance;

  get diagnostics promoted_count = row_count;

  update public.signal_source_records_staging
  set status='promoted', promoted_at=now()
  where dataset_id=dataset_row.id
    and status='staged'
    and record_kind='business_phone'
    and phone_e164 ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$'
    and nullif(trim(payload->>'business_name'),'') is not null;

  update public.signal_datasets
  set ingestion_status='promoted', updated_at=now()
  where id=dataset_row.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'datasetKey', dataset_row.dataset_key,
    'promotedRows', promoted_count,
    'sourceKey', source_row.source_key
  );
end
$function$

    left(s.payload->>'business_name', 300),
    nullif(s.payload->>'category',''),
    nullif(s.payload->>'locality',''),
    nullif(s.payload->>'source_url',''),
    now(),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'pipeline','signal_promote_business_staging',
      'dataset_key',dataset_row.dataset_key,
      'dataset_id',dataset_row.id,
      'source_record_fingerprint',s.source_record_fingerprint
    )
  from public.signal_source_records_staging s
  where s.dataset_id=dataset_row.id
    and s.status='staged'
    and s.record_kind='business_phone'
    and s.phone_e164 ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$'
    and nullif(trim(s.payload->>'business_name'),'') is not null
  on conflict(source_id, source_record_id, phone_e164) do update set
    country_code=excluded.country_code,
    business_name=excluded.business_name,
    category=excluded.category,
    locality=excluded.locality,
    source_url=excluded.source_url,
    fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at,
    provenance=excluded.provenance;

  get diagnostics promoted_count = row_count;

  update public.signal_source_records_staging
  set status='promoted', promoted_at=now()
  where dataset_id=dataset_row.id
    and status='staged'
    and record_kind='business_phone'
    and phone_e164 ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$'
    and nullif(trim(payload->>'business_name'),'') is not null;

  update public.signal_datasets
  set ingestion_status='promoted', updated_at=now()
  where id=dataset_row.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'datasetKey', dataset_row.dataset_key,
    'promotedRows', promoted_count,
    'sourceKey', source_row.source_key
  );
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.signal_report_reputation(p_phone text, p_country_code text, p_national_number text, p_line_type text, p_category text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  uid uuid := auth.uid();
  n public.signal_numbers;
begin
  if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required'; end if;
  if p_category not in ('spam','scam','sales','harassment','safe_business','other') then raise exception 'invalid_category'; end if;
  if p_phone !~ '^\\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' then raise exception 'invalid_phone'; end if;

  insert into public.signal_numbers(phone_e164,country_code,national_number,line_type)
  values(p_phone,upper(p_country_code),p_national_number,p_line_type)
  on conflict(phone_e164) do update set
    country_code=excluded.country_code,
    national_number=excluded.national_number,
    line_type=case when excluded.line_type <> 'unknown' then excluded.line_type else public.signal_numbers.line_type end,
    updated_at=now()
  returning * into n;

  insert into public.signal_reputation_reports(number_id,reporter_id,category,status)
  values(n.id,uid,p_category,'pending')
  on conflict(number_id,reporter_id,category) do update set
    status='pending',
    created_at=now();

  return jsonb_build_object('recorded',true,'category',p_category);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.signal_sources_public()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'key', source_key,
        'name', display_name,
        'kind', source_kind,
        'status', approval_status,
        'license', license_name,
        'publisher', publisher,
        'homepage', homepage_url,
        'licenseUrl', license_url,
        'ingestionMode', ingestion_mode,
        'attributionRequired', attribution_required,
        'enabled', enabled,

        'accessRequirement', access_requirement,
        'contains', contains
      )
      order by
        case approval_status when 'approved' then 0 when 'quarantined' then 1 else 2 end,
        priority,
        display_name
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  from public.signal_source_catalog
  where approval_status <> 'rejected';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.signal_temp_stage_foursquare(p_token text, p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO '[WITHHELD LITERAL]'
AS $function$
declare
  expected_dataset constant uuid := '[WITHHELD LITERAL]'::uuid;
  inserted_count integer := 0;
begin
  if p_token is distinct from '[WITHHELD LITERAL]' then
    raise exception '[WITHHELD LITERAL]';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> '[WITHHELD LITERAL]' then
    raise exception '[WITHHELD LITERAL]';
  end if;

  if jsonb_array_length(p_rows) > 1500 then
    raise exception '[WITHHELD LITERAL]';
  end if;

  insert into public.signal_source_records_staging (
    dataset_id,
    source_record_fingerprint,
    record_kind,
    raw_phone,
    phone_e164,
    country_code,
    payload,
    status,
    rejection_reason
  )
  select
    (r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]')::uuid,
    r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]',
    r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]',
    r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]',
    r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]',
    r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]',
    coalesce(r->'[WITHHELD LITERAL]','[WITHHELD LITERAL]'::jsonb),
    '[WITHHELD LITERAL]',
    null
  from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) as r
  where (r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]')::uuid = expected_dataset
    and r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]' = '[WITHHELD LITERAL]'
    and r->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]' ~ '[WITHHELD LITERAL]'
    and nullif(trim(r->'[WITHHELD LITERAL]'->>'[WITHHELD LITERAL]'),'[WITHHELD LITERAL]') is not null
  on conflict (dataset_id, source_record_fingerprint) do update set
    raw_phone = excluded.raw_phone,
    phone_e164 = excluded.phone_e164,
    country_code = excluded.country_code,
    payload = excluded.payload,
    status = case
      when public.signal_source_records_staging.status = '[WITHHELD LITERAL]'
        then public.signal_source_records_staging.status
      else '[WITHHELD LITERAL]'
    end,
    rejection_reason = case
      when public.signal_source_records_staging.status = '[WITHHELD LITERAL]'
        then public.signal_source_records_staging.rejection_reason
      else null
    end;

  get diagnostics inserted_count = row_count;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    '[WITHHELD LITERAL]', expected_dataset,
    '[WITHHELD LITERAL]', inserted_count
  );
end;
$function$

queries.structure:
with ns as (select oid,nspname from pg_namespace where nspname !~ '^pg_' and nspname <> 'information_schema'),
objects as (
select 'relation' kind,n.nspname||'.'||c.relname identity,jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls_enabled',c.relrowsecurity,'rls_forced',c.relforcerowsecurity,'persistence',c.relpersistence,'view_definition',case when c.relkind in ('v','m') and n.nspname='public' then pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) end) details from pg_class c join ns n on c.relnamespace=n.oid where c.relkind in ('r','p','v','m','S','f')
union all
select 'column',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attname,jsonb_build_object('type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'ordinal',a.attnum,'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'default',case when pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) ~* '(sb_secret_|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20}|''[^'']{32,}'')' then null else pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) end,'default_md5',md5(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid)),'default_withheld',coalesce(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) ~* '(sb_secret_|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20}|''[^'']{32,}'')',false)) from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid=a.attrelid join ns n on n.oid=c.relnamespace left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=c.oid and d.adnum=a.attnum where c.relkind in ('r','p','v','m','f') and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped
union all
select 'constraint',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||k.conname,jsonb_build_object('type',k.contype,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true),'validated',k.convalidated,'deferrable',k.condeferrable,'deferred',k.condeferred) from pg_constraint k join pg_class c on c.oid=k.conrelid join ns n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
union all
select 'index',n.nspname||'.'||ic.relname,jsonb_build_object('table',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready) from pg_index i join pg_class c on c.oid=i.indrelid join pg_class ic on ic.oid=i.indexrelid join ns n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
union all
select 'trigger',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||t.tgname,jsonb_build_object('definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true),'enabled',t.tgenabled,'internal',t.tgisinternal,'function',t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join ns n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
union all
select 'policy',schemaname||'.'||tablename||'.'||policyname,jsonb_build_object('permissive',permissive,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',qual,'with_check',with_check) from pg_policies where schemaname in (select nspname from ns)
union all
select 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,jsonb_build_object('kind',t.typtype,'base',case when t.typbasetype<>0 then format_type(t.typbasetype,t.typtypmod) end,'enum_labels',(select jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel order by e.enumsortorder) from pg_enum e where e.enumtypid=t.oid)) from pg_type t join ns n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where t.typtype in ('e','d')
union all
select 'extension',e.extname,jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'version',e.extversion,'relocatable',e.extrelocatable) from pg_extension e join pg_namespace n on n.oid=e.extnamespace
union all
select 'schema_grant',n.nspname||':'||case when a.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) end||':'||a.privilege_type,jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantable',a.is_grantable) from ns n cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce((select nspacl from pg_namespace where oid=n.oid),acldefault('n',(select nspowner from pg_namespace where oid=n.oid)))) a
union all
select 'relation_grant',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||':'||case when a.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) end||':'||a.privilege_type,jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantable',a.is_grantable) from pg_class c join ns n on n.oid=c.relnamespace cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault(case when c.relkind='S' then 's'::"char" else 'r'::"char" end,c.relowner))) a where c.relkind in ('r','p','v','m','S','f')
union all
select 'default_grant',n.nspname||':'||pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole)||':'||d.defaclobjtype::text||':'||case when a.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) end||':'||a.privilege_type,jsonb_build_object('grantable',a.is_grantable) from pg_default_acl d join ns n on n.oid=d.defaclnamespace cross join lateral aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a
) select kind,identity,details from objects order by kind,identity
queries.routines:
with f as (select p.*,n.nspname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) args,case when p.prokind in ('f','p') then pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) end def from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname !~ '^pg_' and n.nspname <> 'information_schema'),
x as (select *,nspname in ('vault','pgsodium') or def ~* '(create_secret|update_secret|sb_secret_|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20}|''[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{32,}'')' or proname='signal_temp_stage_foursquare' sensitive from f)
select 'function' kind,nspname||'.'||proname||'('||args||')' identity,jsonb_build_object('schema',nspname,'name',proname,'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(oid),'identity_arguments',args,'returns',pg_get_function_result(oid),'language',(select lanname from pg_language where oid=prolang),'kind',prokind,'security_definer',prosecdef,'volatility',provolatile,'strict',proisstrict,'parallel',proparallel,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(proowner),'configuration',proconfig,'definition_md5',md5(def),'definition',case when nspname='public' and not sensitive then def end,'body_withheld',coalesce(sensitive,false),'secret_dependent',coalesce(sensitive,false) or proname ~* '(get_secret|get_gateway_key|get_gateway_token|get_issuer|private_key|signing_material|signing_seed|server_material|store_issuer|store_gateway|store_signing|provision_issuer|runtime_value|mint_ticket|sign_message)','staging_sanitized_definition',case when proname='signal_temp_stage_foursquare' then regexp_replace(def,$rx$'([^']|'')*'$rx$,$rep$'[WITHHELD LITERAL]'$rep$,'g') end,'grants',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',case when a.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) end,'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'grantable',a.is_grantable) order by a.grantee,a.privilege_type) from aclexplode(coalesce(proacl,acldefault('f',proowner))) a),'anon_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',oid,'EXECUTE')) details from x order by identity
queries.additional:
select 'column_grant' kind,n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attname||':'||case when x.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) end||':'||x.privilege_type identity,jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor),'grantable',x.is_grantable) details from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid=a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace cross join lateral aclexplode(a.attacl) x where n.nspname !~ '^pg_' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'
union all select 'sequence',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,jsonb_build_object('type',format_type(s.seqtypid,null),'start',s.seqstart,'increment',s.seqincrement,'min',s.seqmin,'max',s.seqmax,'cache',s.seqcache,'cycle',s.seqcycle) from pg_sequence s join pg_class c on c.oid=s.seqrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname !~ '^pg_'
union all select 'domain_constraint',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname||'.'||k.conname,jsonb_build_object('definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true),'validated',k.convalidated) from pg_constraint k join pg_type t on t.oid=k.contypid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where n.nspname !~ '^pg_' order by 1,2
queries.sensitivePolicies: select 'policy' kind,schemaname||'.'||tablename||'.'||policyname identity,jsonb_build_object('permissive',permissive,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',null,'with_check',null,'expression_withheld',true,'secret_dependent',true,'expression_md5',md5(coalesce(qual,'')||coalesce(with_check,'')),'sanitized_using',regexp_replace(qual,$rx$'([^']|'')*'$rx$,$rep$'[WITHHELD LITERAL]'$rep$,'g'),'sanitized_with_check',regexp_replace(with_check,$rx$'([^']|'')*'$rx$,$rep$'[WITHHELD LITERAL]'$rep$,'g')) details from pg_policies where policyname in ('signal_overture_temp_insert','signal_overture_temp_select') order by identity
